verdict.rationale: AutoGen's built-in agents and teams accept natural-language tasks, e.g. `agent.run(task="Find information on AutoGen")`, and UserProxyAgent lets a human give feedback to the team during a run. But the product itself is set up through Python code, JSON or drag-and-drop in AutoGen Studio, not through natural-language commands. missing for 10: natural-language operation or configuration of the framework or Studio itself, any documented conversational control surface beyond task strings passed in code, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: result = await agent.run(task="Find information on AutoGen")
AssistantAgent is a built-in agent that uses a language model and has the ability to use tools.
The UserProxyAgent is a special built-in agent that acts as a proxy for a user to provide feedback to the team.
